---
title: "Workflow reference"
---


The R workflow starts from integer feature counts, sample metadata, and supplied taxonomic labels. Shannon uses natural logarithms and all original features. Top-eight selection and Other apply to the composition display.

The supplied scripts produce descriptive summaries. Study design, pairing, confounding, and statistical inference require decisions beyond these plots.

Use [Run the workflow](../../01-run-the-workflow.qmd) for commands and [Write a report](../../02-write-the-report.qmd) for the report template.

## Terms used in the figures

| Term | Meaning in this workflow |
|---|---|
| Feature | A row in the count table, such as an OTU or another supplied microbial feature |
| Count total | Sum of all feature counts in one sample; not a measure of total microbial biomass |
| Relative proportion | Feature count divided by that sample's count total |
| Observed features | Number of features with a positive count in one sample |
| Shannon diversity | Summary of richness and evenness, using natural logarithms |
| Other | All features outside the top eight, pooled only for display |

Zero proportions contribute zero to Shannon and are omitted from the logarithm calculation. The same displayed feature can change proportion when other features change; proportions alone do not measure absolute abundance.
